title: Dick Billings on doctoring the Zapruder film in Rochester

tellings.quote: Dick Billings and knew all about how they they brought it to Rochester and doctorred it. He he sat and told me about the whole thing.

plain: In 1963 the Zapruder film, the home movie that caught President Kennedy's assassination, was supposedly taken to Rochester, New York, and altered there. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this. He says a man named Dick Billings, linked in Sheehan's account to the magazine publisher Henry Luce, "sat and told me about the whole thing." If true, the best-known film of the killing would not show what really happened.
